Captions.ai is a general-purpose AI video editing app, made by the company that renamed itself from Captions to Mirage in September 2025. It adds subtitles, generates AI avatars, and applies automated edits to video clips. On its Max plan it applies AI edit styles, generates B-roll, music and images, and turns a long video into a batch of post-ready clips. But it cannot schedule posts or plan your week. You still find a scheduling tool and post everything yourself. Its Trustpilot rating is 4.5 stars, though some reviewers report app freezes and credits running out.

Does Captions.ai post to social media for you?
No. Captions.ai is a video editing tool only. It can publish a finished video to TikTok, Instagram or YouTube, but it cannot schedule posts. You export your video and handle posting yourself.
Does Captions.ai create graphics or write captions?

No. Captions.ai only handles video editing and AI-generated subtitles. It does not create social media graphics, write SEO and AEO-optimized captions, or produce hashtag strategies. VEXI makes graphics in your brand, writes the captions and edits your videos — all included in every plan.
What do Trustpilot reviewers say about Captions.ai?
